description: Camera specifications for autocalibration. Pixel sizes from sensor datasheets.
notes: sensor_pixel_size_um is the physical pixel pitch on the sensor die. Effective pixel size depends on resolution (binning) and objective magnification.

TUCSEN-LIBRA-25.name: Tucsen Libra 25 (TUCam)
TUCSEN-LIBRA-25.notes: Hardware-verified on this rig: USB\VID_5453&PID_E437, driver TUUSB3, mono 16-bit. Capability 0 RESOLUTION = [0 = 5200x4096 'Resolution', 1 = 2600x2048 'Sensitive']; 'Sensitive' is 2x2 binning, so it does NOT change the field of view. 2600x2048 is listed FIRST because that is what the preview auto-selects. sensor_pixel_size_um is null ON PURPOSE: the pitch is not published in anything verifiable here, and a guessed value would show as a plausible 'theoretical um/px' that a real calibration is then judged against. Measure it with Mosaic & Camera Calibration; see gui/widgets/tucam_backend.py.

TUCSEN-GENERIC.name: Tucsen (TUCam, other model)
TUCSEN-GENERIC.notes: Fallback entry for any other Tucsen body on the TUCam SDK (Dhyana / Aries / FL). Resolutions are read from the camera at start, so leaving preview_resolutions empty is correct — the device reports its own. Pitch unknown; measure um/px.

ZYLA-4.2P.name: Andor Zyla 4.2P (USB3)
ZYLA-4.2P.notes: ANDOR ZYLA-4.2P-USB3-2V3 sCMOS, 6.5 um pixel, mono 16-bit. Preview resolutions are on-sensor binning presets (2x2/4x4/8x8/1x1). BINNED 1024x1024 is listed FIRST on purpose: it is the default live-preview mode — full 2048x2048 (1x1) is heavy for a live feed (large frames + ~840MB ring buffer). Driven via Andor SDK3 (pylablib); see gui/widgets/andor_backend.py.
